Record rule matching, action results, and timings for troubleshooting.\nStart recording, reproduce the issue, then stop. The record will be saved automatically.

Diagnostics record rule matching, action results, and timings to help investigate rules that fail, trigger incorrectly, or run slowly.

How to use
1. Start recording.
2. Open the affected app and reproduce the issue.
3. Return and stop recording, or stop from the notification.
4. Tap Share on a diagnostic record to export logs with the selected record and send them to the developer. About → Export logs includes all saved diagnostic records.

Include the expected behavior, actual behavior, and steps to reproduce when reporting an issue.

Logs may contain app information and screen content. Review before sharing.

If you can reproduce the issue, record it under Settings → Diagnostics and stop recording. Then use About → Export logs to export logs including the diagnostics. Attach them to your report with the steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
In automation mode, pause companion accessibility in the selected apps to avoid accessibility detection notices caused by the companion service

Companion accessibility helps automation work in some apps and helps keep GKD running in the background. GKD starts and stops it automatically.

It is a specially configured lightweight accessibility service with negligible overhead in everyday use.

In automation mode, if an app detects accessibility, select it under Pause companion. The companion service pauses when you enter that app and resumes when you leave.
